title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: combining several acceptances on one booking
content:
## Rule
Acceptances of the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product that sit on one booking are combined by the strictest category among them. A new application is accepted only when the live acceptances already on the booking are fewer than the lowest maximum-per-booking figure among the new category and the categories already live on the booking. Categories whose booking may not also carry another category exclude one another and every other category: a booking that carries a live acceptance of AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers, AHL DG Compressed Gases or AHL DG Special Approval may carry no second acceptance, and an acceptance of one of those three categories may not join a booking that already carries a live acceptance. The customer who needs to ship both must use separate bookings.

## Counting the live acceptances on the booking
- Current state of the records on the handling date, on the booking concerned.
- An acceptance is live when its status is submitted, under review, approved or loaded.
- The acceptance being handled is left out.

The count rests on the line's records of each acceptance's booking, status and category, correlated by the booking, and is taken before the new application is admitted.

## Decision steps
1. Collect the categories of the live acceptances on the booking and add the category of the new application.
2. Take the lowest maximum-per-booking figure among those categories.
3. Compare the number of live acceptances already on the booking with that lowest figure: accepted only when the number is fewer.
4. Independently, where the booking already carries a live acceptance, it cannot take the new application if the new application or any live acceptance on the booking belongs to one of the three exclusive categories.

## Worked cases (hypothetical per-booking figures)
| Case | Live on the booking | New application | Lowest figure | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 2 acceptances of a category with figure 4 | category with figure 3 | 3 | 2 is fewer than 3: accepted |
| B | 3 acceptances of a category with figure 4 | category with figure 3 | 3 | 3 is not fewer than 3: refused |
| C | 1 live acceptance of AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | any category | — | refused: the booking may carry no second acceptance |
| D | 1 live acceptance of any category | AHL DG Special Approval | — | refused: it may not join a booking that already carries one |

## Points of judgement
- *Does a withdrawn or rejected acceptance on the booking count as live?* No; only submitted, under review, approved and loaded acceptances are live for this count.
- *Is the figure of the new category alone decisive?* No; the lowest figure among the new category and the categories already live on the booking governs.
